title: Romantic Getaway to Japan | A Cultural Odyssey Across Tokyo, Kyoto & Osaka
highlights: Enjoy a romantic journey through Japan’s diverse landscapes, where ancient shrines, vibrant cities, and scenic wonders weave an unforgettable cultural escape.
Step into history at Sensoji Temple, Tokyo’s oldest Buddhist temple, where incense smoke, vibrant pagodas, and cultural energy come alive in every corner
Wander through Nakamise-dori Street, a centuries-old market lined with colorful stalls, offering local snacks, souvenirs, and a taste of Edo-period charm.
Set sail on a pirate ship cruise across Lake Ashi, where serene waters and mountain views transport you into a surreal world straight from a storybook.
Walk the sacred path through Fushimi Inari Taisha, where thousands of vermilion torii gates wind through the forest, creating a spiritual and surreal trail.
overview:
About the Tour:
Embark on a romantic journey through Japan that beautifully blends modern wonders with timeless traditions. Begin your adventure in vibrant Tokyo, exploring iconic landmarks like the Meiji Shrine, the Imperial Palace, and the towering Tokyo Skytree, along with serene cruises and magical moments at Tokyo Disneyland. Also, marvel at Mt. Fuji from the 5th Station and shop at Gotemba Outlets, featuring global brands. Glide over Hakone’s volcanic valley on the ropeway and cruise Lake Ashi. Continue to historic Kyoto and Nara to wander through vermilion torii gates at Fushimi Inari and feed deer in Nara Park. Ride the scenic Sagano Railway and stroll through Arashiyama’s Bamboo Grove. In Osaka, relive samurai history at Osaka Castle and experience movie-themed thrills at Universal Studios Japan. From cultural wonders to enchanting scenery, this couple’s Japan getaway promises memories that last a lifetime.

know_before_you_go: ID proof is mandatory for each guest at the time of booking and also upon arrival. PAN card will not be considered a valid address proof.
All international participants will have to share passport and visa details on arrival.
Learn basic Japanese phrases like "Konnichiwa" (hello) and "Arigatou" (thank you).
﻿﻿Remove your shoes when entering someone's house, a traditional house, or a temple in Japan.
Always remember not to leave chopsticks upright in a bowl of rice, as it's considered disrespectful.
Using your phone for calls during a train or bus journey is considered inappropriate etiquette in Japan.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Tokyo | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome to Japan! Upon arriving at Narita International Airport, get transferred to your hotel. After checking in, spend the rest of your day at leisure, where you can explore Ginza, Tokyo’s upscale retail district known for luxury shopping and sleek architecture, or enjoy a live show at the Samurai Theater. Also, you can relax with a peaceful stroll through the greenery of Yoyogi Park or feel the pulse of the city at the iconic Shibuya Crossing, where Tokyo’s vibrant energy comes alive.

items.title: Check-in at Shinjuku Washington Hotel Annex

days.title: Tokyo Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, head to Shinjuku Love Statue to board the bus for city's tour. Start by travelling past attractions like Godzilla Head, Takeshita Street & Omotesando. Explore Akihabara & Kappabashi Dougu Streets, famed for their lively vibe. Don't miss Meiji Jingu Shrine, famous for its wooden torii gate & Sensoji Temple, known for its Kaminarimon Gate. Also, try matcha desserts, a traditional Japanese offering, before getting driven to Shinjuku St. West Exit. From there, head to the hotel on your own.

items.title: Tokyo Sightseeing Tour - Departure from Shinjuku LOVE Statue (With Lunch)

days.title: Trip to Mt. Fuji 5th Station, Hakone & Gotemba Outlets
days.desc: In the morning, head to the Shinjuku Center Building meeting point and board your transfer for an unforgettable day trip. Begin at Mt. Fuji’s 5th Station, where stunning views of mountain ranges await. Continue to Gotemba Premium Outlets, where you can shop from top global brands. Next, get driven to Hakone and ride the Hakone Ropeway over the surreal Ōwakudani Volcanic Valley. Conclude with a pirate ship cruise on Lake Ashi before getting driven to JR Shinjuku Station’s West Exit.

items.title: Trip to Mt Fuji 5th Station, Hakone & Gotemba Outlets

days.title: Day Trip to Disneyland
days.desc: Today, gear up for a magical day at Tokyo Disneyland, one of Asia’s most beloved theme parks. Once there, step into World Bazaar, a nostalgic recreation of a 20th-century American town. Also, you can explore vibrant zones like Adventureland, Tomorrowland, and Fantasyland, featuring iconic attractions like It’s a Small World and Peter Pan’s Flight. Enjoy a day filled with thrilling rides, spectacular parades, character meet-and-greets, and whimsical themed dining—a dreamlike escape for all ages.

days.title: Transfer to Kyoto | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Post check-out, head to the Shinjuku Station on your own and board the iconic bullet train to Kyoto, known for its speed and comfort. Upon your arrival at the Kyoto Station, make your way to the hotel and check in. Spend the rest of your day at leisure, where you can relax or you can head out and stroll through the historic grounds of the Kyoto Imperial Palace. Also, you can explore Gion, Kyoto’s famous geisha district or visit the Rurikoin Temple, known for its stunning architecture.

items.title: Transfer in Bullet Train (Shinkansen)
items.desc: 1 X Bullet Train (Shinkansen) will be Provided

items.title: Check-in at Kyoto Ryokan Gion Sano

days.title: Transfer to Osaka | Osaka Walking Tour
days.desc: Post checkout, head to Kyoto St. & board the bullet train to Osaka. Upon arrival, check in at the hotel. Later, head to Exit 2 of Tanimachi 4-Chome St. for Osaka walking tour. Begin with Osaka Castle, known for its stunning structure & beautiful gardens. Next, wander through Koreatown, dedicated to the famous Korean culture. Also, explore Tennoji Ward, where you can visit Harukas, Japan’s tallest non-tower building & Dotonbori, a hub of delicious street food & iconic experience.

items.title: Transfer in Bullet Train (Shinkansen)
items.desc: 1 X Bullet Train (Shinkansen) will be Provided

items.title: Check-in at APA Hotel Shin Osaka Ekimae

days.title: Day Trip to Universal Studios
days.desc: Today, get driven for a full-day adventure at Universal Studios Japan, one of Asia’s premier theme parks packed with cinematic excitement. With your Express Pass, skip the long queues and dive straight into blockbuster worlds like Harry Potter, Jurassic Park, Minions, and Spider-Man. Also, stroll through the Wizarding World of Harry Potter, hop on adrenaline-pumping rides and enjoy interactive attractions. Don’t miss the magical parades or live shows that bring your favorite films to life.

days.title: Visit to Kyoto,  Nara & Arashiyama | Arashiyama Sagano Train Experience
days.desc: Today, get driven to Nippombashi Street & board the transfer for your adventure today. Visit Nara Park & feed various deer roaming freely & Fushimi Inari Taisha & its pathway of thousands red torii gates. Next, get driven to Kyoto St. to board the train to Torokko Saga St. Upon arriving, enjoy the unique Sagano Scenic Railway journey along the Hozugawa River to Arashiyama. Disembark at Arashiyama St. & enjoy a walk through the Bamboo Grove & Kimono Forest. Later, get driven back to the hotel.

items.title: Kyoto & Nara Sightseeing Tour - Departure from Osaka
Arashiyama Sightseeing Tour - Departure from Osaka

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: In the morning, check out from your hotel in Osaka and board your transfer to Kansai International Airport. As you head for your flight back home, reflect on the unforgettable memories from your romantic getaway—where timeless temples, scenic landscapes, thrilling adventures, and cultural encounters came together to create the perfect journey through Japan.
